watch.en: The Q3 presentation frames 2029 as the Jakafi transition and prioritizes growth beyond Jakafi.
watch.zh: 第三季度演示文稿将 2029 年定位为 Jakafi 的过渡期,并将 Jakafi 之外的增长列为优先。

watch.zh: Povorcitinib 结节性痒疹 III 期数据预计在 2026 年第四季度公布。

watch.en: September cash and marketable securities totaled $3.9 billion after the Vega acquisition.
watch.zh: 收购 Vega 后,9 月现金及有价证券合计 $3.9 billion。

watch.en: INCB123667 enrollment in Phase 3 platinum-resistant ovarian cancer was stopped as focus shifted to maintenance.
watch.zh: 随着重点转向维持治疗,INCB123667 在 III 期铂耐药卵巢癌中的入组已停止。

gaps: No numerical phase is disclosed for INCA035784 in the portfolio text; phase is null. The company uses clinical-proof-of-concept/pivotal categories, which were not guessed into numerical phases.

INCB123667 is represented by its ongoing Phase 2 MAESTRA-1 study; Phase 3 MAESTRA-2 enrollment was discontinued and MAESTRA-3 had not yet been confirmed started. Presentation corroborates ongoing Phase 2 status.
INCA33890 is also written INCA033890 in parts of the Q3 release. Merus collaboration for INCA33890 and INCA035784 is stated in the portfolio footnotes.
Origins were not verified for povorcitinib, tafasitamab, INCA033989, INCB161734 or INCB123667; origin is null. Unverified development codes are null.
Counts is null: portfolio totals are not counts by numerical phase. No next milestone date was verified for INCA035784.
Approved ruxolitinib cream and axatilimab were excluded because their new-indication programs had not been verified as filed. Their studies are not treated as registration.
